summary: Backend-only regression for Xtream Provider Verification slice. Full PHPUnit suite: 148/148 passing (442 assertions, 4.41s). All 12 Tests\Feature\Provider\XtreamVerificationTest cases green (23 assertions). Route `filament.admin.pages.settings/provider-verification` confirmed via `php artisan route:list` at path `admin/settings/provider-verification`. Livewire AmbassadorActivation.php line 89 explicitly zeroes `$this->provider_password = ''` inside the finally block; no other persistence sites for the raw password found. Password-isolation test (no row in settings or audit_logs contains distinctive password 'super-secret-pw-xyz-2026') passing. Container binding cases (a/b/c), all 7 verifyActiveCustomer branches, probeConnection diagnostics writes (last_response_code/last_success_at/last_note='reachable'), and Filament canAccess() super-admin gating all pass via feature tests.

specific_cases_verified: missing dns url raises provider unavailable
test connection records last response code
password is never persisted or logged
verification disabled swaps in disabled driver for non fake config
settings page is gated to super admin
settings update persists and takes effect on next container resolve

findings: Line 89: $this->provider_password = '' inside finally block — clears after activation attempts
Line 103: passed into VerifyCustomerRequest constructor (marked #[SensitiveParameter] per spec)
No other sites in app/ read/write provider_password to storage, logs, cache, or session

critical_code_review_comments: XtreamVerificationDriver correctly records diagnostics (last_response_code as string, last_success_at/last_failure_at ISO 8601, last_note) via SettingsRepository on every attempt — verified through the 12 driver tests.
DomainServiceProvider container binding logic honours the spec: driver=xtream + enabled=1 -> Xtream; enabled=0 with non-fake driver -> Disabled no-op; fake is exempt (never demoted).
Filament ProviderVerificationSettings::canAccess() is gated on super_admin role — plain admin correctly rejected. Same guard applies to the base Settings page.

Password isolation: Livewire finally block zeroes provider_password; grep confirms no persistence of the distinctive test password across settings/audit_logs tables. Meets 'never stored, logged, queued, audited, cached, or persisted' requirement.

config/provider.php intentionally omits DNS/timeout from env — pulled from SettingsRepository schema (provider.xtream_dns_url, provider.timeout_seconds). Matches spec that these are DB-backed, not env-backed.
test_credentials: Not required — all verification flows exercised via Http::fake against DNS 'iptv.example.test' inside phpunit; no live preview URL hit for Xtream driver.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline is now 148 tests / 442 assertions. Preview default remains PROVIDER_VERIFICATION_DRIVER=fake — Xtream driver is only exercised via Http::fake in unit tests. Filament page at /admin/settings/provider-verification is gated by canAccess()==super_admin; live URL hit not part of test scope (TOTP MFA required by Filament middleware). If future slices touch DomainServiceProvider binding order, keep 'fake exemption' branch intact (case c).
